title: Kijun-sen Bounces and Rejections

edits.reason: lessonChart is the worked SHORT setup (Kijun Rejection in Downtrend) and already draws the Kijun entry level + the Short Entry/Rejection events, but the Stop and Target — the rest of the trade triad — are referenced in the lesson text yet not drawn. Lesson bullet teaches the target for shorts explicitly: 'Target: prior resistance (for longs); prior support (for shorts)' — prior support sits at the 71 downtrend-resume low (dataIndex 17), so a Target line at yAxis 73 (just above 71, inside the 71-120 band, teal=take-profit) names where the 2+R is realized (lesson body: 'The setup typically delivers 2+ R'). The Stop is the symmetric counterpart of the long's stop ('Stop: below the most recent swing low with a buffer') applied to the short: above the rally swing high. The rally tops at the 97 leg (dataIndex 8-9), so a Stop line at yAxis 99 (~2% above the swing high, inside band, pink because it sits against the short) closes the triad. No new markPoints needed — the Entry/Rejection events are already pinned.

notes: introChart (long bounce concept, band ~73-134) already draws the Kijun line + Entry/support/2+R markPoints; as a CONCEPT/intro slot it illustrates the bounce mechanic, so leaving the full stop/target triad off is acceptable restraint. quiz.chart has cutIndex:10 and correctly shows only the Kijun decision level (yAxis 103) pre-cut, with the outcome (Reversion, Long Entry at Kijun, 2+R) routed to revealMarkPoints — adding more pre-reveal would spoil the decision, so it is complete. REJECTED the auditor's third lessonChart gap (relabel the Kijun line from 'Kijun-sen — Rejection Level in Downtrend' to 'Kijun-sen — Short Entry'): the Kijun line should retain its identity as the dynamic 50% Fib level (the chapter's core teaching), the Short Entry EVENT is already pinned at dataIndex 8 ('Rally to Kijun — Short Entry!'), and the rejection-level label is accurate — relabeling would be redundant with the markPoint and erode the level's pedagogical identity. APPROVED the auditor's Stop (yAxis 99) and Target (yAxis 73) additions; note the auditor's stop quote ('Stop: beyond the previous swing high (for shorts)') is actually from chapter 26 — within chapter 25 the short stop is justified by symmetry with the taught long stop, so the addition stands but is grounded in ch25's own short-target bullet rather than that mis-sourced quote.
